raw_source_description: Labels in row of plants 1 (top). || plant <f100v>[1,3] - many dark leaves, dark roots. East of plant <f100v>[1,3], ground level. Kluge's 33A. Grove's L3.3.

Labels in row of plants 2 (bottom). || plant <f102v1>[2,1] - four-lobed truncated tuber with bunch of roots at the bottom; lanceolate leaves with serrated edges. East of plant <f102v1>[2,1], ground level. Grove's 30.
Labels in row of plants 2 (bottom). || West of plant <f102v1>[2,3], ground level. Grove's 15.

Labels in row of plants 1 (top). || plant <f102v1>[1,5] - long pinnate leaves, "bunch of fingers" root East of plant <f102v1>[1,4], ground level. Grove's 16. The @'&Cy;' looks funny, and lies East of the presumed original binding fold.
Labels in plant row 2. || plant <f102v2>[2,4] - pine-like leaves, thin light stem East of plant <f102v2>[2,4], ground level. Grove's 17.
Circle of seven labels above some of the moons. || Moon at 02:30, light yellow. The gallows has half of a hook at the end of the horz arm, so it is halfway between @p and @w.
Text lines in sectors with moons. || Sector at 06:30, line 1. Grove's T11.1.
Star labels in sectors between points of big central star. || Labels read outwards. Numbered clockwise, starting at 10:30. Sector at 10:30. Grove's L1.
Labels inside top half of central circle. || Top right quarter of central circle.
Labels in star/nymph band 1 (outer). || Label at 00:30. Kluge's 07A. Star/nymph at 00:00? <!S??> = star, 7 points
Labels in row of plants 1 (top). || plant <f89r2>[1,2] dark roots, flowers?, grassy at base of stem East of plant <f89r2>[1,2], below leaves. Latham's t.3. Kluge's 34A in <f89v>. Grove's X.8.
